brief.line: Opens correctly; the character loads; controls are visible
Audio respects browser user-gesture requirements; no loud audio on page load
Tap produces a note; animation synchronisation
No unnecessary audio delay
Audio playback respects browser user-gesture requirements
All required gesture types produce appropriate musical responses
Clear alternatives for people who cannot or prefer not to perform gestures
Breathing influences the rhythm
The sounds remain harmonious even during rapid interaction
Character-specific sounds; Web Audio synthesis; smooth sound transitions; squeeze introduces a warm bass tone
Volume control
Mute
Visual-only mode
Replay sound sequences
Save favourite sound combinations
Interactions involving two Mallows create harmonies
Animation synchronisation; reduced motion works; reactions are correct
No flashes (photosensitivity: at most ~3 bright events a second)
Background behaviour: nothing runs or plays while hidden
Exit works; state cleanup is correct; no leaks when switching features
Feature state remains isolated from other experiences
Highly responsive mobile layouts; no clipping or overlapping; the Mallow remains the centre of attention
Accessibility (keyboard); privacy; no paid APIs and no unnecessary network requests
Touch does not accidentally trigger unwanted browser scrolling
